text:
2. 1. 3. 10. 

30. Dvāhaṃ bhikkhave atthavase sampassamāno araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevāmi. Katame dve? Attano ca diṭṭhadhamma sukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañca janataṃ anukampamāno. Ime kho ahaṃ bhikkhave dve atthavase sampassamāno araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevāmīti.
